description: Figure 5 presents two pie charts side-by-side for error analysis, with the left chart corresponding to the Vanilla model and the right to the HCL model. The left pie chart for the Vanilla model is divided into four segments: “Atomic Skill Fail” (68.0%, dark teal), “Correct” (12.0%, medium teal), “Reason Error” (12.0%, light teal), and “Question Misunderstood” (8.0%, very light teal). The right pie chart for the HCL model also has four segments: “Atomic Skill Fail” (55.0%, dark teal), “Correct” (21.0%, medium teal), “Reason Error” (14.0%, light teal), and “Question Misunderstood” (10.0%, very light teal). A legend above the charts identifies each category by color. The charts visually indicate that the HCL model reduces the proportion of “Atomic Skill Fail” errors while increasing the “Correct” responses compared to the Vanilla model.
